اشترعا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَعَا (ištaraʕā) /iʃ.ta.ra.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# اُشْتُرِعَا (ušturiʕā) /uʃ.tu.ri.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# اِشْتَرِعَا (ištariʕā) /iʃ.ta.ri.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
